words.sense: Mood or atmosphere conveyed by a place or setting
misconceptions: Confusing a social network with room decoration.

words.sense: Social or cultural surroundings shaping a person
misconceptions: Assuming a place can have only one kind of surrounding.

semantic_axes.description: Ambience is the mood a setting creates; milieu is the social or cultural environment in which people live and develop.

beats.text: Farah grows up among actors who trade scripts, attend each other's shows, and treat rehearsal as part of daily life.
beats.decisive_clue: daily life shaped by an artistic community
beats.reason: The initial evidence is daily life shaped by an artistic community; it best supports milieu.

beats.text: Their rehearsal room has yellow walls.
beats.decisive_clue: daily life shaped by an artistic community
beats.reason: Paint colour does not explain the shared practices shaping her life.
